about: Virar West is a fast-growing coastal residential locality at the northern end of Mumbai's Western Suburbs, the terminus of the Western Railway suburban line, home to Bolinj, Agashi, Arnala and Rajodi beaches. It is one of the most affordable housing belts in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

faq.question: What is Virar West known for?
faq.answer: Virar West is known for being the western terminus of the Mumbai suburban railway, its affordable housing, the coastal beaches of Arnala and Rajodi, the historic Arnala Fort, and the nearby Jivdani Temple. It is one of the fastest-growing residential belts in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Virar West?
faq.answer: Virar West comes under pin code 401303, covering localities like Bolinj, Agashi, Narangi and the Virar West station belt.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Virar West?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Virar West are Bolinj, Agashi, Narangi, Rajodi, Arnala, Virar Phata, Yashwant Nagar and Manvel Pada.

faq.question: What is the property price in Virar West?
faq.answer: Property prices in Virar West range from ₹28 lakh for a 1BHK in Narangi/Virar Phata to ₹55–75 lakh for a 2BHK in Bolinj, and ₹75 lakh–1 Cr for premium 2BHK/3BHK in Agashi/Arnala Road belt. Rental rates range from ₹7,000 to ₹18,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Virar West?
faq.answer: Virar West is the terminus of Western Railway's Virar local line, with fast trains to Churchgate (75–90 min) and to Dahanu Road on the MEMU. It is served by feeder auto rickshaws, VVMC and BEST bus routes, and direct access to the Western Express Highway (NH-48) and the upcoming Virar–Alibaug Multimodal Corridor.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Virar West?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Virar West include Sanjeevani Hospital, Cardinal Gracias Memorial Hospital (Vasai), Platinum Hospital, Sai Multispeciality Hospital and several VVMC and trust-run clinics serving the Bolinj and Agashi belt.

faq.question: Which schools are in Virar West?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Virar West include St. Francis High School, Holy Cross Convent High School, Rustomjee Cambridge International School (Virar), Vidya Vikasini High School and N. L. Dalmia/Universal English Schools serving the Bolinj and Agashi area.
